description: This file defines a service for an Android app widget, including a RemoteViewsService implementation and a RemoteViewsFactory for managing widget items.

classes.name: StackWidgetService
classes.description: A service that provides RemoteViewsFactory for the widget's collection view.

classes.name: StackRemoteViewsFactory
classes.description: Implements RemoteViewsFactory to supply data and views for the widget's collection.

methods.name: onGetViewFactory
methods.description: Returns a new instance of StackRemoteViewsFactory for the widget.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes widget items and simulates delay for loading.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of widget items.

methods.name: getViewAt
methods.description: Creates and returns RemoteViews for a specific position.

methods.name: getLoadingView
methods.description: Returns null for default loading view.

methods.name: getViewTypeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of view types.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the ID for a given item position.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates whether item IDs are stable.

methods.name: onDataSetChanged
methods.description: Handles data refresh when widget data changes.
